summary:
## Goiko: summary

**An individual cannot franchise Goiko in Spain.** Goiko doesn't franchise in Spain. In 2024 it directly ran 117 restaurants in Spain and France. After L Catterton bought the chain, all locations belonged to the fund and it stopped granting franchises. The only route for an investor is a territorial alliance such as Canarias, Baleares or Portugal, not a single unit. That route doesn't cover Madrid.

**Operator:** The parent is InternationalBurgerCo. Capza took control at the end of 2025 and holds 98% (a third-party figure). Other sources say about 90%.

**Health:** 2025 sales fell 11% to €109M. Net loss was €36.4M.

**Premises:** There is no franchise model, so no franchisee premises model exists. I labelled `rent_model` "market_lease" only as an assumption, because the company leases its own sites. No source states the occupancy terms.

**Figures:** Fee, royalty, investment and floor area are null. Old directory figures (€12–50k fee, €80–190k fit-out) come from low-quality sites that describe a franchise that doesn't exist, so I excluded them. Cost ratios are generic Spanish restaurant benchmarks, not Goiko data. Rent is bundled into `other_opex`.

**Recommendation:** Don't plan around Goiko. Consider franchised Spanish burger brands that offer individual units.

data.eligibility_explanation: Goiko is company-run in Spain (117 own restaurants in 2024) and has not franchised since L Catterton's 2018 purchase. Expansion outside its own operation is through territorial joint ventures (Canarias, Baleares, Andorra, Portugal), not single-unit franchises. No Madrid franchise exists.
data.operator_in_spain: InternationalBurgerCo (Goiko), controlled by Capza since late 2025

spain_store_count.source: https://burgerbreton.com/en/brands/goiko/ (third_party_estimate; cites the official restaurant finder, Oct 2026). Filing-based: 111 Goiko + 6 Basic by Goiko in Spain in 2024, https://lexpress-franchise.com/es/ultimas-noticias/goiko-dispara-perdidas-36-millones/

data.rent_model_explanation: Assumption only: there is no franchise, so no franchisee premises model exists. Goiko operates its own sites and its occupancy terms are not published. No source shows a franchisor-property or % of sales occupancy arrangement.

auv_eur.source: Derived: €109M 2025 sales (https://www.hispanidad.com/economia/goiko-se-atraganta-en-2025-reduce-ventas-11-dispara-perdidas-160_20000017_102.html) / 117 restaurants (2024 count, lexpress-franchise URL above)
auv_eur.label: third_party_estimate
auv_eur.note: Group-level average. Includes delivery and the 700 m2 flagship. Uses the 2024 store count because the 2025 count is unknown.

unit_m2.label: third_party_estimate
unit_m2.note: Two press-reported units. The Puerta del Sol flagship is 700 m2 and is excluded as an outlier.

cogs_pct.label: third_party_estimate
cogs_pct.note: Generic Spanish restaurant benchmark, not Goiko-specific.

labour_pct.label: third_party_estimate
labour_pct.note: Generic Spanish restaurant benchmark, including social security.

royalty_pct.note: No franchise exists, so there is no royalty.

marketing_pct.note: Bundled in other_opex to avoid double counting.

other_opex_pct.label: third_party_estimate
other_opex_pct.note: Includes market rent (6–12%), utilities (2–5%), other operating costs (8–10%) and marketing. Madrid-weighted high end. This is the author's sum of benchmark ranges, not a single source figure.

investment_eur.note: No credible Goiko-specific figure. The €80–190k fit-out figures on montarnegocios.es are unverified and describe a non-existent franchise.

notes: No Spain-specific or non-Spain FDD exists for Goiko.
Capza stake: ~90% (CB Insights/Expansión, Jan 2026) vs 98% (burgerbreton, citing El Debate).
Sales are falling (-11% in 2025) and losses are record (€36.4M), so any partner or investor route carries brand risk.
The 2015 El Economista piece says three of six early locations were franchised with a founder-friendly arrangement. That model has been discontinued.
Directory pages (btopadvisor, infofranquicias) show no fee, royalty or area data.
